diagnosis.rootCause: The stable Tauri application identifier reused the existing IndexedDB settings and therefore selected the previously configured external library instead of the bundled demo seed. The selected library has no active or historical V20 visual source accepted by the backend.
diagnosis.inferenceBoundary: The exact external library path was not read from browser storage. The installed seed was validated read-only, and the backend can emit this stable code only after opening the configured library and finding no accepted visual source.

change.behavior: AGENT_IMMERSIVE_VISUAL_SOURCE_MISSING automatically selects the existing static background and emits a bounded informational notice. Payload deadlines, mount timeouts, invalid active snapshots, revision mismatches, database errors and all other failures remain terminal.

privacy: No Cookie, credential, ticket, account field, raw institutional page, or browser-storage value was read, copied, logged or persisted.
nextGate: Commit the scoped compatibility change, rebuild Full Demo from that clean commit, audit it, install over the explicit test installation and verify non-blocking startup plus normal exit.
